title: Main sonchta hoon kay Abid ka haal kya hogaa
body:
Main sonchta hoon kay Abid ka haal kya hogaa
Aseer ho kay woh jab Shaam mein gayaa hogaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Sunaa hai Shaam mein jaatey hi khoon ronay lagaa
Na jaaney shimr ney us waqt kya kahaa hogaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Mujhey yaqeen nahin aathaa yaqeen kaisey karoon
Ali ki Laadli Beti ka sar khulaa hogaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Woh yaad karta toh hogaa Pidar ki shaahi ko
Bahan ko dafn jo kurtay hi mein kiya hogaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Galay kay touq ney Abid ko kya jhukaana thaa
Woh apney khoye huvey Laal dhoondtha hogaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Woh yaad karta toh hogaa Pidar ki ghurbath ko
Watan mein jab usay ghusl-o-kafan milaa hogaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Rasool Zaadiyaan bey maqnaa aur woh khaamoush
Meray Imam ka kis darjaa hauslaa hogaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Woh zulm deikhay hain Sajjad ney Hussain kay baad
Mujhey yaqeen hai ab takh bhi ro rahaa hogaa
